page.overview:
Who is Cagnazzo?

Cagnazzo is a voidsent who serves as a character and boss in Final Fantasy XIV: Endwalker. Formerly a Roegadyn from the Thirteenth reflection of the Source, he, like all denizens of the star, was consumed by the Flood of Darkness which rendered him into an aether-starved beast known as a voidsent. As a voidsent, he served Golbez as the archfiend of water.

Before he was called Cagnazzo, he was a fisherman of modest means. Due to the ongoing aetherical imbalance caused by the raging war, the Contramemoria, fish had become less abundant and harder to obtain. Living with his brother, whom he shared a fishing business with, Cagnazzo became fed up with his boring, meagre life and decided on a whim to participate in the war. He quickly found two Memoriates fighting and intervened, defeating one of them with his bare fists. The other, thinking him an ally quickly approached him until the man who would be known as Cagnazzo began to attack him too. Sometime later, he was found by his brother among the bodies of the two defeated Memoriates. Claiming he never felt so alive, he decided to dedicate his life in earnest to battle, walking away and leaving his brother in the dust. Never again would he see his younger brother's face, too hungry for the thrill of combat.

His brother would later hear of a mighty warrior who would intervene in conflicts with his bare fists, defeat everyone and walk away. People took him for a feral hound, and named him Cagnazzo, a name he would carry until swallowed by the Flood..|name=Shadowed Pasts Once More}}

After the Flood of Darkness, Cagnazzo established a Domain, using his control over water to trap and drown voidsent without any challenge and building his power through this. He, however, never satiated his hunger. It was only until he met Golbez, who gifted him a portion of his massive aether reserves, feeling full for a moment, that he remembered that his hunger wasn't for aether, but for the thrill of battle. Due to this he began to serve Golbez willingly, in order to fight even greater foes and once more fill that hole in his life.
